title: Sweep · area:fleet · week of 2026-11-20: small low-risk fleet tooling fixes batched into one PR
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 2026-11-20 ~06:3xZ, verbatim: 「同意」, on triage's proposal to batch small, low-risk, non-urgent work into recurring sweep cards that one seat ships as one PR, to save the per-card fixed cost (session start, CI, review, queue slot, approvals). Asked and answered: 「只有p3可以这样吗」 — not only p3: small p2 also qualifies. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：车队工具（脚本、门禁、流程文字）的扫尾卡，本周的小改动集中在这里，一个 PR 做完。
- 为什么：每张小卡单独开发都要走一遍会话、测试、审核和排队，合起来走一次，省掉大部分固定开销，也少很多卡。
- 收什么：小、风险低、晚几天修也不要紧的 p3 和 p2；不收 p1、错数据、安全项、天天碰到的问题和大改动。
- 要你做什么：无（涉及受管文件时照常批）。


## What enters (triage moves rows here at first touch or in its daily pass)
- Any p3 small fix, and any p2 that is small (one file or one mechanism), low-risk and not hit daily: shipped-text fixes, review follow-ups with a user effect, minor UI copy.
- ⛔ Never: p1; a p2 that computes wrong data, is a security item, or breaks a daily path; work of size M or larger; topic children (the topic already batches); claimed or started cards.

## How it ships
- Once a week the lane's seat claims this card and ships **one PR** of at most ~10 rows that touch unrelated, low-risk spots. Rows it does not reach roll to next week's card of this name.
- Each row names its source card; the source card is closed as folded and its body stays the detail. The PR lists the rows it closes.
- The card closes when its PR merges; triage opens next week's card.
